verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents background automation of its own. Customers can be placed under ongoing monitoring through a monitoring-configuration API. Its marketed agentic workflows include Screening/Monitoring and Transaction Monitoring agents that auto-remediate level 1 alerts and auto-escalate high-risk cases. Asynchronous and batch screening, with WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks, supports unattended processing. However, the agent evidence is marketing-level only, and the Starter plan configuration cannot be customized, so how far users can design their own automations is unproven. missing for 10: user-configurable automation/workflow builder or rule scheduling docs, technical docs on how agents are set up and scoped, independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous agent operation.
